title: Protect active work with an isolated launch branch
promptExcerpt: Implement the August portfolio launch without disturbing current local changes.
decision: Create a dedicated worktree, extend existing Nuxt and theme APIs, and commit only launch-owned files.
result: Portfolio work can be reviewed and shipped independently while the original modified checkout remains intact.
learning: AI-assisted delivery is safer when repository boundaries, verification, and evidence are part of the interface to the coding agent.
